elaborately curled/patterned hair rendered in rows of tight ringlets
long layered beard with regular curl rows

justification:
Both depict a bearded male head in strict profile with a fillet and hair and beard rendered as regular tiered rows of tight curls, carved in shallow relief with incised interior detailing 
called out in the same conventional way. However, A shows two such figures confronting each other with a raised handled bowl, hands, garments and an inscribed field, whereas B pairs its single figure with two large ram heads over a scale-like ground pattern, so the scenes and internal relationships differ substantially.
